14360
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,
JUN 1 1 1939

Merchants Still
Being Detained

An Accused Said to Be
Relative of Gen. Chiang
Kai-shek ; Police Silent

Chen Kwong-tsung and a man by
the name of Chiang, who, it will be
recalled, were arrested by detectives
from Crime Branch Headquarters,
on Friday morning, were still being
questioned yesterday and their
release, which Chinese sources had
forecast for yesterday, did not
materialize. Whilst police quarters,
approached for details on the affair
yesterday, refused to make any
statement, it was reliably learnt that
the Japanese authorities requested
the apprehension of the two men,
on the basis of a document which
the Japanese produced and which
indicated that Cheng was Chief of
Staff and Chiang Colonel-in-Chief of
a guerilla unit operating in Kiangsu
province. Cheng, it was learned
yesterday, had been one of the
chiefs of the Bureau of Public
Safety of the City Government of
Greater Shanghai, for five years
prior to the outbreak of hostilities in
1937.

The authenticity of the document
in which the two men are quoted as
being high guerilla officers, is at
present being checked, it was under-
stood, whilst the men are being
questioned and their past records
investigated. According to one source,
Chiang is said to be a distant cousin
of the Generalissimo, but this could
not be confirmed. It was neverthe-
less presumed that considerable im-
portance is attached to the two
arrests, the silence on the part of
police officials seemingly confirming
this.

The two men, it will be recalled,
are the managing director and
director respectively, of the Far
Eastern Trading Co., at 150 Kiangse
Road, where they were arrested by
detectives from S. M. P. Head-
quarters.

The firm, which these two men
head, is engaged in various lines of
business and when it was first
formed, in 1937, bought Wei Wah
currency on the market. As far as
could be learned from Chinese
sources, the two men have had no
political affiliations whatsoever since
the outbreak of hostilities and were
said to be prosperous businessmen
who attend their office daily.

They are at present being detained
at Police headquarters.

蒋介石将军的亲属；警方保持沉默

陈光宗和一名姓蒋的男子，
回想一下，他们于周五上午被
罪案股总部的侦探逮捕，昨天仍在
接受讯问，中方消息源曾预测
他们将于昨天获释，但并未
实现。虽然昨天有人向警方部门
询问此事详情，但警方拒绝发表
任何声明，不过可靠地获悉，
日本当局基于一份文件要求
逮捕这两人，该文件由日方出示，
表明陈是参谋长，蒋是
在江苏省活动的一支游击队的
上校团长。据悉，陈在1937年
战事爆发前的五年里，曾任
大上海市政府公安局局长之一。

目前正在这两人受审并调查
其过往记录的同时，核实引用
两人为高级游击队军官的文件
的真实性。据一位消息源称，
蒋据说是委员长的远房表亲，
但这无法得到证实。尽管如此，
人们推测这两起逮捕事件受到
相当重视，警方官员的沉默似乎
证实了这一点。

回想一下，这两人分别是
江西路150号远东贸易公司的
总经理和董事，他们是在那里
被上海公共租界工部局警务处
总部的侦探逮捕的。

这两人领导的公司从事各种
业务，并在1937年最初成立时，
在市场上购买维华货币。据从中
方消息源了解，自战事爆发以来，
这两人没有任何政治关联，据
说是每天去办公室上班的富裕
商人。

他们目前被拘留在警察总部。
向这位受欢迎的警官告别。

（批注：Lili C 13/6）

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. REGISTRY
JUNE 17, 1939 D. F. 299/6
Date ____

Information from an authentic source has been received
to the effect that PAN SAI SING (潘三省), apart from being the principal
sponsorer of the ASIA CLUB, a gambling establishment at No.65,
Gordon Road, has invented new means of enriching himself by
assisting the local Japanese Gendarmerie in effecting the arrest
of wealthy class Chinese living in the foreign Settlements who
are accused of being guerilla units and in bringing about a
final settlement of the case through the payment of a handsome
sum of money.

It is learnt that the victims in such cases are
generally people of independent means, chiefly those who were
formerly connected with government offices and who have since
retired owing to political changes after having accumulated
considerable wealth during their tenure of public service.

An illustration of such procedure is borne out by
the arrest in conjunction with the Shanghai Municipal Police
of two male Chinese from Room 101, Bank of Canton Building,
Kiangse Road, Managing-Director and Director respectively of
the Great China Co., a trading concern situated at this address,
who are accused of being high members of a certain guerilla unit.
Despite the fact that both accused are still in the custody of
the Shanghai Municipal Police, it is reported that an understanding
has been reached between the Japanese Authorities and the
family of Chen Kwok Tsoong (陳國宗), residing at 8/500 Rue du Roi
Albert, whereby a sum of $100,000 has been secretly paid over.

Chen Kwok Tsoong, it is further reported, is disliked
by LOO YING, ex-Chief of the Detective Branch of the defunct
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, who now holds the post of
Commissioner of the Peitung Police.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 17 JUNE 1939）

从可靠来源收到的信息显示，潘三省（潘三省）除了是戈登路65号赌博场所“亚洲俱乐部”的主要赞助人外，还发明了新的致富手段，即协助当地日本宪兵队逮捕居住在外侨聚居区、被指控为游击队成员的富有阶层中国人，并通过支付巨额款项促成案件的最终解决。

据悉，此类案件的受害者通常是拥有独立资产的人，主要是那些以前与政府机关有联系，并在任职期间积累了大量财富，后因政治变动而退休的人。

此类程序的一个例证是，上海公共租界工部局警务处联合逮捕了两名中国男子，他们来自江西路广东银行大楼101室，分别是位于该地址的贸易公司“大华公司”的总经理和董事，被指控为某游击队的高级成员。尽管两名被告仍被上海公共租界工部局警务处拘留，但有报道称，日本当局与居住在阿尔贝王路8/500号的陈国宗（陳國宗）家属之间已达成谅解，秘密支付了10万美元。

另有报道指出，陈国宗不受陆英（音译）喜欢，陆英是已解散的上海公安局侦探科前科长，现任北平警察局局长。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1939年6月17日）

2.

Reference to the twelve letters seized
by the Japanese members of Crime Branch Headquarters
in the home of the 2nd accused in this case and
subsequently detained by the French Police, same
were handed to the undersigned by Mr. Jobes on
the morning of June 10th 1939.

These letters have since been translated
and a perusal of same show that they contain nothing
that would in any way support the allegations as
made by the Japanese authorities.

Most of these letters, which have been
sent to the 2nd accused by various relatives in
the war zone, tend to show that these persons
have been forced to contribute various sums of
money to the Chinese Government War Fund, and
that they were also forced to contribute various
sums to the relief, but there is no evidence to
show that the accused has contributed to any of these
funds.

这些信件此后已被翻译，经审阅显示，其中不包含任何能以任何方式支持日本当局所指控内容的材料。

这些信件大多是由战区内的各种亲属寄给第二被告的，倾向于表明这些人被迫向中国政府的战争基金捐款，并被迫向救济基金捐款，但没有证据显示被告曾向任何此类基金捐款。

Dear "Kong Tseong",

On the last occasion we were
given notice to pay $80.00 for the Anti-Japanese
& Self Defence Tax in Zai Bu Hsien. Of this sum
I have paid $30.00 and the remaining $40.00 which

1938年9月24日。

亲爱的“庚忠”：

上次我们接到通知，需缴纳嵊县（Zai Bu Hsien）的抗日自卫税80.00元。这笔款项中我支付了30.00元，剩余应由你支付的40.00元已被有关当局催缴数次。此次要求你支付150.00元，而我需支付15.00元。不知我们将如何应对。随信附上嵊县（Zai Bu Hsien）抗日自卫委员会要求缴纳上述款项的两份通知书。

Translation of the gist of a letter
addressed to Sang Kong Tseong, House 4,
Lane 800, Ave. du Roi Albert, by Sang
Kwang Tung in Zai Bu Hsien.
----------------------------------------

3-10-38.

Dear "Kongg Tseong",

Sang Tsu Voh wishes to recommend
young brother "Lih" to be a Captain at Yeong Chia,
but he refused this offer and reproached Mr. Sung.
Uncle "Sung" also tried to get him a job as a
captain of the Defense Corps, but he is not willing
to work.

The Anti-Japanese & Self Defence
Tax for you is $150.00 and for young brother,
Kwang Tung, is $10.00. After a protest being made,
your amount was reduced to $75.00, but Kwang Tung
had already paid his $10.00. The authorities
concerned insisted on Kwang Tung paying your
tax, but since he is in straitened circumstances,
I had advanced $65.00 for you by pawning my gold
finger ring. Please refund it to me in your
earliest convenience. Enclosed please find the
receipt for the same amount.

From : Sang Kwang Tung.

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,
JUN 1 O 1939

Police Arrest Two
Chinese Merchants
Guerilla Activities
Charged by Japanese ;
Still Being Held

Following the request of the Japan-
ese authorities, S. M. P. headquarters'
detectives raided the premises of the
Far Eastern Trading Company at 150
Kiangse Road yesterday morning and
took Chen Kwong-tsung and another
man by the name of Chang, Director
and Managing Director respectively,
into custody. The two men were
taken to headquarters where detec-
tives commenced investigations, re-
portedly taking as a basis, Japanese
allegations that the detained business-
men were connected with the
guerillas movement one being an
alleged general and the other a major
of one of the units operating behind
the Japanese lines.
The Far Eastern Trading Co. is a
Chinese-owned concern which was
founded some two years ago and
whilst it is engaged in many lines of
business and brokerage, its main pur-
pose at the time of its foundation
was the buying of Wei Wah funds
for conversion into cash. Whilst it
was understood from Chinese sources
that up to a late hour last night,
investigations made into the records
of the two men concerned revealed
nothing which would in any way
connect them with the guerilla move-
ment, it was also learned that some
years prior to the outbreak of
hostilities in 1937, Chen was a Gov-
ernment official, although it could
not be ascertained with which section
of the Government he had been
connected.
The two men are at present being
detained at police headquarters and
it was not believed unlikely that they
would be released today, in the event
that their connections with the
guerilla movement could not be
definitely established.
Police quarter, questioned on the
subject of the arrests, made no
statement.

（批：R. 1/6）
（批：Lee）
（批：Cig）

《字林西报》，
1939年6月10日

警方逮捕两名
中国商人
日方指控其参与
游击活动；
目前仍被拘留

应日本当局的要求，公共租界警务处总部侦探于昨天上午突袭了江西路150号的远东贸易公司（Far Eastern Trading Company） premises，并将该公司董事陈光宗（Chen Kwong-tsung）和另一名姓张的经理拘捕。两人被带往总部，侦探随即展开调查，据称调查依据是日方的指控，即这两名被拘留的商人与游击运动有关联，其中一人被指为将军，另一人为在日本防线后方作战的某部队少校。
远东贸易公司是一家华人拥有的企业，成立于约两年前，虽然从事多种业务和经纪活动，但其成立时的主要目的是购买维华基金（Wei Wah funds）并兑换成现金。虽然从中方消息源获悉，直到昨晚很晚时候，对这两名相关人员记录的调查并未发现任何能将他们与游击运动联系起来的证据，但也得知在1937年战事爆发前数年，陈曾是一名政府官员，尽管无法确定他隶属于政府的哪个部门。
目前两人被拘留在警察总部，如果无法确证他们与游击运动的联系，预计他们今天可能会被释放。
警方辖区在被问及逮捕事宜时，未作声明。

（批注：R. 1/6）
（批注：Lee）
（批注：Cig）

At about 10.45 a.m. 9.6.39 D.I. Nakamura
reported to D.I. Glover that the Japanese Water Police
wished assistance to arrest two male Chinese at an
address on Klangan Road immediately as they were
suspected of being concerned in Anti-Japanese
activities and that they were in possession of
two pistols.

The necessary assistance was given by D.S.I.
Crighton D.S.I. Bowes, D.S. Sugimoto, D.P.S. Yamahara,
Chinese party and the undersigned and at 11 a.m.
same date, the Japanese party led detectives to
room 101 of the Bank of Canton Building, Klangan
Road, where they pointed out the Great Eastern
Co. and stated that the persons they wished to
arrest used in that company.

1939年6月9日上午10点45分左右，中村侦探督察（D.I. Nakamura）向格洛弗侦探督察（D.I. Glover）报告称，日本水上警察希望立即协助在康安路（Klangan Road）某地址逮捕两名中国男子，因为他们涉嫌参与反日活动，并且持有两支手枪。

克雷顿副督察长（D.S.I. Crighton）、鲍尔斯副督察长（D.S.I. Bowes）、杉本侦探警长（D.S. Sugimoto）、山原侦探巡长（D.P.S. Yamahara）、中方人员及签署人提供了必要的协助。同日中午11点，日方带领侦探前往康安路广东银行大楼（Bank of Canton Building）101室，他们指出了大东公司（Great Eastern Co.），并表示他们希望逮捕的人在该公司办公。

In reference to attached application for assistance the undersigned questioned Sgt.
